data_description.declination: 0 = horizontal, 90 = vertical. Ignored for tilt-axis and dual-axis trackers; you can leave the default value. Otherwise enter the actual panel tilt.
data_description.azimuth: 0 = North, 90 = East, 180 = South, 270 = West. Ignored for azimuth and dual-axis trackers; you can leave the default value. Otherwise enter the actual panel heading.
data_description.tracking: Select the axes that follow the sun. Dual-axis tracking ignores both angle fields; fixed panels use both. Omitted angles keep their displayed defaults.
